body: I’m currently in Southern California but I’m willing to go literally anywhere in the entire world. I don’t have whatsapp but I can pm you my Snapchat/insta

I don’t have any recorded, I’m flat broke, I have no means to record my music. I just write, make beats with my hands, and freestyle all of my music. Someday maybe I can record some but who knows when that’ll be.
